controls.name: identity passthrough
controls.role: Bit-exact baseline on speech-like, silence and impulse stimuli; any gain stage must be compared against it.

controls.name: fixed and energy-matched static gain
controls.role: Non-adaptive level control separated from target convergence and loudness-standard claims.

controls.name: direct RMS/gain-law oracle
controls.role: Deterministic dB rule or ideal gain law; a learned or adaptive stage must beat it before selection.

controls.name: silence floor and pause bypass
controls.role: Undefined RMS must fall back to identity, and pauses must not be raised toward the target.

controls.name: clipped and overloaded input with peak ceiling
controls.role: Pre-clipped and near-clip probes with an explicit ceiling; clipping counts and output peaks are reported, not hidden.

controls.name: hard-clip degraded anchor
controls.role: A deliberately degraded control for load/intelligibility-shaped envelope proxies; never a listening or STOI substitute.

controls.name: chain-order and interacting-nonlinear control
controls.role: AGC, compressor and limiter ordering is exercised so smoothing, ceiling and gain-law interactions are observable.

controls.name: predicted or proxy versus human separation
controls.role: Envelope correlation, windowed RMS error and gain-law RMSE are developer proxies, never STOI, MOS or preference ratings.

controls.name: same-filter measurement versus independent meter
controls.role: FFmpeg loudnorm self-measurement is labelled self-measured; an independent BS.1770/EBU Mode meter is a separate gate.

historical_executions.label: Static target-RMS gain with hard peak ceiling on synthetic level stimuli
historical_executions.scope: Deterministic synthetic 16 kHz mono fixture with chirps, steps, impulses, silence and speech-like surrogates; no real speech, corpus, device gain, listening or loudness-standard result; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Ridge static-gain synthetic held-out screen with envelope-AGC and direct-rule controls
historical_executions.scope: Train and held-out splits are both synthetic harmonic/formant signals; the ridge model is worse than the direct rule it approximates; no real speech, listening or model-selection claim; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Envelope AGC synthetic fixture with ceiling and interacting-nonlinear controls
historical_executions.scope: Deterministic synthetic AGC at 10 ms attack, 250 ms release, -18/+18 dB bounds, -24 dBFS target and 8 Hz gain smoothing; gain-step tracking was worse than identity and no listening or real-speech result exists; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Feed-forward compressor synthetic amplitude and frequency sweep
historical_executions.scope: Causal envelope detector, symmetric attack/release and static gain law at threshold -24 dBFS, ratio 4, 5 ms attack and 120 ms release; synthetic only, no lookahead, side-chain, model or listening result; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Full-band receive DRC synthetic gain, headroom and attack/release measurements
historical_executions.scope: Causal soft-knee full-band compressor at threshold -18 dB, ratio 3, ceiling 0.95 with optional limiter OFF by default; synthetic speech-like and analytic fixtures only, no listening or device timing; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Peak limiter reference synthetic clean-speech, impulse and nonfinite probes
historical_executions.scope: Task-local Python model of a documented zero-lookahead limiter with per-sample ceiling/peak gain and one-pole release; the nonfinite probe records C++ std::min/std::max ordering as observed behavior, not a quality claim; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: EBU R128 / loudnorm-style static loudness target on a synthetic paired fixture
historical_executions.scope: Minimal Python offline loudness analyzer plus static-gain frame adapter on a 2.5-second synthetic paired fixture; not FFmpeg, not a BS.1770/EBU Mode meter, no EBU test set, LRA target not enforced; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Speex AGC with advisory activity output on synthetic native fixtures
historical_executions.scope: One vendored SpeexDSP preprocessor per stream at 16 kHz with AGC ON and VAD advisory only; gain trajectory is byte-identical with the VAD flag and the activity output never gates audio; synthetic only, no real speech, listening or device result; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Historical AGC gain-step screen on 743 EARS recordings with a noisy DNS2020 extension
historical_executions.scope: Recorded EARS audio with synthetic gain steps and a 30-pair DNS2020 noisy extension; level error improved while SI-SDR/STOI declined, with no clean reference, natural microphone capture, listening or live acceptance; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Historical FFmpeg 7.1 two-pass loudnorm screen on 30 EARS excerpts
historical_executions.scope: Offline mastering screen self-measured by the same filter; no independent BS.1770/EBU Mode meter, EBU test set, complete programme or live-enhancement result exists, and FFmpeg is absent from this worktree; not rerun by this survey.
